title: UCHUM506 – Introduction to Indian Constitution Course Registration Started
details:
Non-KTU Registration: UCHUM506 (Indian Constitution)

Course: UCHUM506 – Introduction to Indian Constitution (MOOC by JAIN University)
Fee: ₹100

How to Register (via KTU Portal):
1. Log in to KTU Student Portal.
2. Go to Non-KTU/Previously Done Course Registration Request → Click Add.
3. Enter course details, submit, and proceed to payment.
4. Pay ₹100 via HDFC/Federal Bank (Card, UPI, or Net Banking).
